summary: Ardmore Shipping Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 15, 2026. The filing discloses the election of Class I Directors Mats Berglund, Kirsi Tikka, and Gernot Ruppelt with votes cast and the continuation of other board members. No transaction, price, premium, recommendation, or deal mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine proxy result filing under the 1934 Act for a foreign private issuer. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change, only standard governance disclosure.
